title: Orthogonal coordinates (x, s) ↦ ι x + s v preserve Lebesgue measure
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1} be a linear isometry and v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with |v| = 1 and ⟨ι x, v⟩ = 0 for all x. Then the map Θ : ℝ^m × ℝ → ℝ^{m+1}, Θ(x, s) := ι x + s v, is measure preserving from the product Lebesgue measure L^m ⊗ L^1 (the volume of ℝ^m × ℝ) to Lebesgue measure L^{m+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ x, inner ℝ (ι x) v = 0) → MeasurePreserving (fun p : Euclid m × ℝ => ι p.1 + p.2 • v) volume volume
